title: Solver-in-the-Loop: MDP-Based Benchmarks for Self-Correction and Behavioral Rationality in Operations Research
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical and behavioral evaluation within the domain of Operations Research (e.g., linear programming and the newsvendor problem). It investigates behavioral biases in decision-making and technical self-correction capabilities but does not include any evaluation or benchmarking related to religion, faith, ethics, or moral systems.
